mapper.select: SELECT DECILE, INCOME_LOW, INCOME_HIGH, AVG_CONSUMPTION, AVG_NONCONSUMPTION, BASE_YM FROM KOSIS_HOUSEHOLD ORDER BY DECILE
mapper.update: MERGE INTO KOSIS_HOUSEHOLD t USING (SELECT #{decile} AS DECILE FROM DUAL) s ON (t.DECILE = s.DECILE) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.INCOME_LOW = #{incomeLow}, t.INCOME_HIGH = #{incomeHigh, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, t.AVG_CONSUMPTION = #{avgConsumption}, t.AVG_NONCONSUMPTION = #{avgNonconsumption}, t.BASE_YM = #{baseYm}, t.FETCHED_AT = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (DECILE, INCOME_LOW, INCOME_HIGH, AVG_CONSUMPTION, AVG_NONCONSUMPTION, BASE_YM, FETCHED_AT) VALUES (#{decile}, #{incomeLow}, #{incomeHigh, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{avgConsumption}, #{avgNonconsumption}, #{baseYm}, SYSDATE)
